scope: Theorem 11.1 of the manuscript “Signed tensor densities and diagram budgets for the Thorp shuffle” (preprints/Signed-tensor-densities-and-diagram-budgets-for-coordinate-sweeps-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 69f29b044ee825ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 81-82. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are real exponents p(d) ≥ 1, indexed by integers d ≥ 1, with supd≥1 p(d) < ∞ such that, for every integer d ≥ 1 and every partition λ ⊢ n = 2d, Dλ Tr |Bn|2p(d) ≤ eE+ n (λ) . 81 There is a fixed integer d∗ ≥ 1 above which one may take p(d) = (1 + d−1/2 ) max{p(⌊d/2⌋), p(⌈d/2⌉)}. In particular E+ n ≤ aWλ yields a fixed negative power of Dλ for the sweep norm.
